drivingQuestion: Why is giving the pouch to a gentile preferred to placing it on one's donkey?
outcomeNote: the gentile is preferred because one is not commanded on his rest

segments.he: אֵין עִמּוֹ גּוֹי. טַעְמָא דְּאֵין עִמּוֹ גּוֹי, הָא יֵשׁ עִמּוֹ גּוֹי — לְגוֹי יָהֵיב לֵיהּ. מַאי טַעְמָא? חֲמוֹר — אַתָּה מְצֻוֶּוה עַל שְׁבִיתָתוֹ, גּוֹי — אִי אַתָּה מְצֻוֶּוה עַל שְׁבִיתָתוֹ.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «And if there is no gentile with him» he places it on the donkey. The Gemara infers: «The reason» is specifically because «there is no gentile with him;» if «there is a gentile with him, he gives it to the gentile» and does not place it on a donkey. The Gemara asks: «What is the reason» for this halakha? The Gemara answers: With regard to «a donkey» belonging to a Jew, «you are commanded with regard to its rest» on Shabbat. With regard to «a gentile, you are not commanded with regard to his rest» and no Torah prohibition is being violated.
